newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN GIMV IPO OPEN TO PUBLIC FROM JUNE 10.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN GIMV IPO OPEN TO PUBLIC FROM JUNE 10.

text.p: Shares in Belgian holding company GIMV will be offered to private investors from June 10 and subscriptions close on June 17, GIMV said in a statement on Tuesday.

The fixed price for the shares will be announced on June 10 after book-building with institutional investors in a private placement beginning June 4. Book-building will take place at prices between 1,920 and 2,250 Belgian francs.
The offer will be underwritten by KB-Securities , ASLK-Bank and Bank Degroof.

The main interests of GIMV, the Flemish regional investment company, include 33.5 percent of Belgian electronics firm Barco, a bourse darling, around 10 percent of engineering company BMT and a small interest in Nasdaq-listed printing software firm Xeikon.
It is also a shareholder in Europe's Easdaq growth stocks market.
The Flemish government, which owns 85 percent of GIMV, decided last year to float around 15 percent. Another 15 percent is already in private hands after a private placement in 1995.
The two losing consortia are 1. Banque Bruxelles Lambert, Dexia CC and CERA Bank and 2. Generale Bank, Bank Paribas Belgium and Bacob.
GIMV's stock market listing has been in the pipeline for several years.

Last year the plan hit a snag over what the company should do with its cash mountain -- due principally to the sale last year of interests in Belgian companies such as Plant Genetic Systems NV, Lernout & Hauspie and Innogenetics.
GIMV decided the cash would stay in the company.
